# As-built design summary (generated by tools/report_design.py; do not edit)

Project silkscreen-light-attachment rev A, 2026-09-25. Frames: KiCad K (x_K = X + 100, y_K = 100 - Z) and enclosure E (X, Z; Y up the device). All parts on F.Cu (faces -Y, toward the case).

Board outline bbox (K): x 95.775..164.225, y 80.375..106.225; thickness 1.600 mm; 2 copper layers.

## String voltage sanity

- N = 5 LEDs per string, Rs = 200 R (CRCW0805200RFKEAHP), BAW56 series diode.
- N x Vf at 13.3 mA: 13.00 / 14.25 / 15.75 V (min / typ / max, 25 C); 16.27 V max at -10 C.
- Rs drop 2.66 V at 13.3 mA (2.79 V at 13.96 mA); Rs dissipation 39 mW.
- LED_SW (V_OUT, incl. BAW56 + R37 sense + FET): 16.61 V min hot, 17.98 V typ, **20.36 V worst (cold, max bin)** vs the 22.0 V ceiling (margin 1.64 V) and OVP min 24.25 V (margin 3.89 V).
- Hold-off at ~14 uA hot: 11.5 V > 6.5 V (boost body-diode rule).
- LED_MONIT lit 1.78..2.18 V; open 2.60..2.73 V (separated).
- Hot-plug peak (C9 at OVP, loop 243.5 R incl. Rs 200 R; typ..min LED bin): TPS923610 (25.5 V) 43.7-49.3 mA, TPS923611 (31.4 V) 68.0-73.5 mA, both < IFP 80 mA (IFP is rated at 0.1 ms, 1/10 duty; this pulse lasts ~0.25-1 ms, so the margin is an estimate) (gate). TPS923611 LED_SW-to-GND misinsertion ~79 mA until the OVP latch.
- Verdict: PASS.

## Parts and sourcing

- Rs choice: CRCW0805200RFKEAHP (LCSC C5972814, JLC Extended, 2,477 in stock 2026-09-25): 200 R keeps the TPS923611 hot-plug peak under the LED IFP (review-electrical F3, DESIGN-SPEC sec 7) (checked 2026-09-25 (JLC parts API, JLC Extended)). DigiKey 541-CRCW0805200RFKEAHPCT-ND (DigiKey search page for the MPN, 2026-09-25).
- J1 TSW-102-14-G-D-004 (LCSC C20382277, out of stock 2026-09-25) is **DNP at JLC** (hand-solder; not placed by JLC): buy 612-TSW-102-14-G-D-ND (push out position 4 = J6-12). It stays in bom.csv and is left out of jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv (14 SMT parts).
- LEDs: MPN shared by every CCT; warm = C210340 (3000 K), cool = C210343 (6000 K). DigiKey: n/a - LCSC only (C210340 warm / C210343 cool).
- CPL rotation offsets (EasyEDA footprints, docs/sources/ee_*.json): LED C210340 +0 (pad 1 at -x in both), BAW56 C8663 SOT-23 +180 (EasyEDA pads 1/2 at +x), R 0805 +0 (non-polar). See docs/jlc-notes.md.

## Deviations from DESIGN-SPEC

- Outline step fillets R0.35 (convex) + R0.35 (concave) instead of R0.5: each width step is only 0.70 (x -4.20 -> -3.50 and 63.50 -> 64.20), and two fillets on one 0.70 edge can total at most 0.70 (R0.5 + R0.5 would need 1.00; R1.0 + R0.5 would need 1.50).
- STEP frame: kicad-cli 9.0.6 does not put F.Cu at z_s = 0 / B.Cu at z_s = -1.6 (sec 1). It writes the bare dielectric slab (1.51) at z 0..1.51 and seats F-side models on the component plane z = 1.595. make_outputs calibrates that plane on the J1 body box and maps Y = 118.61 - (z_s - 1.595), X = x_s - 100, Z = 100 + y_s (still a +90 deg rotation about X, det +1). Header tips land exactly at Y 107.94 / 121.40 (asserted); the PCB slab in the E-frame STEP spans Y 118.695..120.205 (copper + mask not modelled) vs nominal 118.61..120.21. Use build/geometry.json (118.61 / 120.21) for fit checks.
- LED silk cathode mark = two short bars along the long sides over pad 1, not a bar across the end: inside a warm/cool pair the pads are only 0.43 apart. F.Fab carries K/A letters and the pin-1 body chamfer.
- LED courtyard is pads + 0.195 (not IPC 0.25) so the 3.8 mm pair pitch leaves 0.04 between courtyards.
- Part keep-outs are enforced by tools/check_handedness.py (courtyard vs keep-out rectangles, height zones), not by KiCad rule areas: the NPTH column holes are footprints that legitimately sit inside keep-outs.
- J1 DigiKey field = 612-TSW-102-14-G-D-ND (the stocked 2x2 TSW-102-14-G-D): push out position 4 (J6-12) before soldering. The -004 MPN stays in the MPN field; J1 is DNP at JLC and hand-soldered by the builder, so it is not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv.
- C2 moved to X 60.90 for a 0.50 edge web: J1's body box is 0.328 from the C2 hole edge (spec: parts 0.4 off the column holes). The Ø3.60 column floats 0.30 in the Ø4.20 hole, so the body keeps >= 0.33 from the column. The gate allows 0.30 for J1 vs C2 only; the 4.2 NPTH courtyard margin is 0.30 (was 0.40) so DRC courtyard overlap stays an error.
- Cool-string links (and the D1-D6 anode bridge) moved from y_K 83.10 to 83.15 so the tracks keep 0.525 from the moved +Z stake holes (z 18.30) and 0.265 from the LED pads.
- Fab outputs (Gerber X2 creation date, kicad-cli/CadQuery STEP, PDFs) carry timestamps; the generated KiCad sources, library and models are byte-identical run to run (KIID seed + uuid rewrite + model stamp).
